headline: Jumia targets Côte d’Ivoire’s informal retail market
summary: E-commerce platform Jumia is pursuing strategies to court Côte d'Ivoire's informal retail market, aiming to capture transactions across French-speaking West Africa.
why: Integrating informal retail networks into digital platforms represents a key growth vector for e-commerce adoption and digital payments in emerging markets.

impacts.name: West African E-Commerce
impacts.why: Jumia is actively expanding its footprint into informal retail markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
